verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's CLI docs show a batch script that installs AnyDesk and sets a password in advance, and note that deployment tools can configure many devices without manual setup on each machine. This is the core of pre-configured credentials. The docs never explicitly say the preset password lets a connection go through without someone at the host accepting it. One community user implies they used AnyDesk this way, but that is not confirmation. missing for 10: explicit documentation that a preset password grants unattended access without host-side acceptance, documentation of unattended-access permission settings, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set up unattended access to a machine with credentials configured in advance, so no one has to sit at the host to accept
